en: Black‑and‑white view of a central square in a small European town. A large tree stands in the middle of the square, fenced around its trunk. Surrounding it are two‑ and three‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. One building on the left has a shop sign for a bakery, and another on the right bears the sign "Ballsaal" (ballroom). In the background rises an ornate church or town‑hall tower with a tall spire and clock. Several children and a few adults stand or walk in the open square, dressed in early 20th‑century clothing.
